rationale: This mutation eliminates the -$10,999 cash deficit by coupling progressive land scaling to a strict 16-plot ceiling (4x4 compact layout matched to 10-11 hands by Day 14) with an in-situ plot servicing pipeline that waters harvested plots immediately without transit delay, recovering 1-2 full Strawberry regrowth cycles. It enforces duration-feasibility gating on town shop contracts to prevent capital lockup in unmaturable slow crops, establishes a hard Day-18 perennial cutoff that pivots late acreage to 3-day Carrots, and purges phantom livestock wheat reserves while calibrating liquidation floors to 0.84x (0.76x under shed crowding) to prevent ruinous 0.60x panic dumps.
